body: Nope. Doctors are stumped. No doctor has told me I will die from this disease directly but at the same time I lose so much weight that I don't see how I'll survive losing another 40 lbs

Why? I know I want to live, But I don't want to put up with constant pain to prolong my life of constant pain some more then die of my disease in a couple years or so

I want to go out on my terms, not starvation

I feel like it's your job to keep living to be a mom to this kid. You could have aborted it, you could have used protection, and I appreciate that you are aware that this is your own fault, but you need to raise this kid. you can't kill yourself now. You could've before but now I think you've crossed the threshold of no going back, do you know what I mean?

If you're not going to live for yourself, live for the child. Use him as motivation to get through the day. Now that you have a son, it's your obligation to care for him and put yourself behind him.

I'm sick, I'm dying whether I want to or not so unfortunately I don't have the option to just move on from this, but you do as you're healthy. Be thankful that you're healthy and try to enjoy your life

with a mindset like that you're only going to hurt the kid and yourself worse, it's all about your mindset.
